skills.skill_desc:
Alice gains 1 stack(s) of <font color="a6aafb">Crimson</font> each time her skill hits an enemy, lasting 4s (up to 2 stacks). <font color="a6aafb">Blood Banquet</font> activates at max stacks.

<font color="a6aafb">Blood Banquet</font>: Every 0.5s, Alice deals 25<font color="62f8fe"> (+30% Total Magic Power)</font> (+ 0.5% - 2.5% target's <font color="26e407"><1005></font>, scaling with level) <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies. She also recovers 10<font color="26e407"> (+3% Extra Max HP)</font> HP and gains 8% Movement Speed. Its duration is refreshed when her skills hit an enemy hero.
Damage to creeps is capped at 70 (+10*Hero Level) <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>.

Alice shoots <font color="a6aafb">Blood Energy</font> forward, dealing 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Before <font color="a6aafb">Blood Energy</font> dissipates, Alice can recast this skill as <font color="a6aafb">Scarlet Shadow</font> to blink to its location.

Alice performs a deadly dance, dealing 350<font color="62f8fe"> (+130% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies and slowing them by 70% for 1s.

If <font color="a6aafb">Blood Banquet</font> is active, the skill also scorches enemies, dealing 300% of <font color="a6aafb">Blood Banquet</font>'s damage and recovering the same amount of HP.

Alice surrounds herself with blood, gaining Control Immunity and 50% Damage Reduction while slowing herself by 50%.

After 1.5s, she descends from above, dealing 500<font color="62f8fe"> (+200% Total Magic Power)</font><font color="26e407"> (+20% Extra Max HP)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to all enemies in range and immobilizing them for 1s.

While charging her Ultimate, Alice cannot use any hero skills other than <font color="a6aafb">Scarlet Shadow</font>.
